node.title: PROVED (autopsy of route a): the anchored-trade bijection — a reparametrization, NOT a bound
node.statement: The active-core pigeonhole hope is DEAD as a bound: the map (anchored trade) <-> (a, sigma) is a proved BIJECTION (verified 132<->132, 18<->18 at the h=3 calibration rows) — it reproduces the known counts exactly and bounds nothing; it is the terminal count in new coordinates. Banked as a lever (a clean parametrization for future arguments), and as falsification-ledger entry material: the route-(a) 'smells provable' intuition refuted by proof.
